---
title: "Resources"
---

Shared, reusable material that supports every course, lab, and exercise across
the academy.

## Templates

Starter templates for new content live under `templates/`:

- `templates/course/` — new course website scaffold.
- `templates/lesson/` — standard lesson layout.
- `templates/lab/` — standard lab layout.
- `templates/quiz/` — standard quiz layout.

Authors are expected to copy from these templates and follow the academy
conventions rather than inventing new structures per course.

## Shared assets

Cross-course assets live under `shared/`:

- `shared/images/` — reusable diagrams, screenshots, logos.
- `shared/icons/` — icon set used across course sites.
- `shared/css/` — shared stylesheets and theme overrides.
- `shared/javascript/` — shared client-side helpers.
- `shared/includes/` — reusable Quarto includes (callouts, prerequisites,
  learning-objectives blocks, and other recurring content).

## Conventions

Open Engineering already publishes convention repositories that inform how
academy content is structured:

- [course-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/course-conventions)
- [curriculum-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/curriculum-conventions)
- [exercise-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/exercise-conventions)
- [lab-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/lab-conventions)
- [lesson-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/lesson-conventions)
- [quiz-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/quiz-conventions)
- [agentic-software-engineering-conventions](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/agentic-software-engineering-conventions) — the seven-phase Agentic Learning Loop applied to substantial Labs.

Substantial Academy Labs follow the
[Agentic Learning Loop](https://github.com/open-engineering-conventions/agentic-software-engineering-conventions):
`Predict → Delegate → Observe → Compare → Generalize → Validate → Internalize`.
Courses teach; Labs train engineering judgement. Lessons, examples, and small
exercises are not required to follow the loop.

## Course metadata

Each course carries a `metadata.yaml` descriptor (see `courses/pico/metadata.yaml`
for the reference example). Machine-readable metadata is what will later drive
curriculum maps, dependency graphs, and other automation without changing
course content.
